text:
Kai: Hey team, woke up with a fever — can't make the 06:00-10:00 UTC oncall window tomorrow. Can someone cover the morning slot? Leaving quick handoff notes below. :wave:

Marta: I can take 06:00-09:00, then @Priya can pick up 09:00-10:00 if that works.

Sam: Thanks Marta. Kai — any risks or scheduled jobs I should be aware of for that window?

Kai: Two things to note: 1) We have a nightly embed prefetch job that runs 05:30 UTC and can load hot keys into the KV cache. If it fails, first ~5 minutes of requests hit cold path. 2) There's a small canary rollout for model v2.1 targeting 10% traffic, TTL 1h — watch for regressions.

Priya: I can take the last hour but need the runbook link & a quick health-check command.

Kai: Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/oncall-handoff (see section "prefetch & canary checks"). Health check command: `curl -sS https://api.redwood.internal/health | jq .` look for `"kv_cache": "ok"` and `"model_serving": "ok"`.

Marta: Got it. I'll watch the prefetch job logs at 05:30: `kubectl -n infra logs job/prefetch-embeds-$(date +%Y%m%d)`. If it errors, I'll trigger a retry with `kubectl create job --from=cronjob/prefetch-embeds prefetch-retry-$(date +%s)` and ping #eng-oncall.

Sam: If the prefetch doesn't complete, should we temporarily raise the autoscale burst for the embed pool?

Kai: Yes — increase pool to 6 GPUs for 20 min via Console -> Dedicated -> Pools -> embed-pool -> Scale. Shortcut if needed: `redwoodctl pools scale embed-pool --replicas=6 --ttl=20m`. That helps absorb cold token spikes.

Priya: Thanks — taking 09:00-10:00. I'll enable extended tracing for the canary during my hour and watch latency dashboards.

ops-bot: Reminder: Scheduled job prefetch-embeds will run at 05:30 UTC tomorrow (cron: 30 5 * * *).

Marta: tagged a short checklist in the handoff doc and left a quick note on runbook about what I did. If anyone else wants to swap, lmk. Otherwise I'll post a brief post-shift summary. :thumbsup:

Kai: Appreciate you all. I'll DM creds for the temporary console access. If anything escalates, ping @oncall-sre and fallback to canary -> stable route.

Sam: Noted. Good rest Kai, feel better. :tea:
